questions.stemHtml: A 55-year-old male presented to the neurology outpatient department with resting tremors, slow movements, and rigidity. Upon further evaluation by the doctor, he was noted to have a stooped posture and also drew very small objects when asked to draw. The condition involves the structure marked in red in the given image. Identify the region of the brain from which this structure originates?
